dogecoin.text: @elonmusk Dear Musk, send me 100,000 Dogecoin to become an investor in the crypto world. When I win, I will return them to you. Don't say anything.

@elonmusk Good evening, 100,000 Dogecoin was requested yesterday. You did not give me an answer of approval or rejection. Is what you are saying true, that cryptocurrencies are for the banks to not control people and to solve their problems? I am waiting for your answer, yes or no.
